title: Implement exclusion strippers for code, quotes, and pastes
description:
Strip non-authored regions before matching: fenced code blocks (backtick and tilde fences) and indented code blocks; markdown blockquote (greater-than prefixed) lines; pasted regions detected by a configurable heuristic (normalized length at least 2000 chars AND (at least 60 percent ASCII OR at least 10 non-blank lines)) — thresholds are config keys, tuned later against the real corpus.

Done when: profanity inside code blocks and quoted text never counts; paste detection fires on synthetic log-paste fixtures and not on coherent prose fixtures; unit tests pass.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: Implemented src/sentiment/exclusions.ts: backtick and tilde fenced code, indented code blocks, blockquote lines, and the pasted-region heuristic (length >= 2000 AND (ascii ratio >= 0.6 OR non-blank lines >= 10)) with all three thresholds configurable via ExclusionThresholds, to be tuned against the real corpus in KDATAP-713a0f. Outcome: green.
